Question: Consortium roles: Which organizations participate in the ALPINE project, what role does each play (coordinator, materials, manufacturing, pilot operation), and which agency funds it?
Cypher Query:
MATCH (o:Organization)-[r:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Project {name:'ALPINE'})
MATCH (p)-[f:FUNDED_BY]->(a:Organization)
RETURN o.name AS organization, r.role AS role, a.name AS funding_agency
ORDER BY (r.role = 'coordinator') DESC, o.name

Question: Publication output: For each project, list its publications together with the authors and their affiliations.
Cypher Query:
MATCH (p:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (pub:Publication)-[:PRODUCED_IN]->(p)
OPTIONAL MATCH (au:Person)-[a:AUTHORED]->(pub)
OPTIONAL MATCH (au)-[:AFFILIATED_WITH {current:true}]->(org:Organization)
WITH p, pub, a, au, collect(org.name) AS affs
ORDER BY p.name, pub.year, a.position
WITH p, pub, collect(au.name + ' (' + CASE WHEN size(affs)=0 THEN 'n/a' ELSE affs[0] END + ')') AS authors
RETURN p.name AS project, pub.title AS publication, pub.year AS year, authors
ORDER BY project, year

Question: Academic lineage: Trace the complete supervision chain for every doctoral researcher (e.g. who is the "academic grandparent" of Sofia Lindqvist and Tomas Berg?).
Cypher Query:
MATCH (s:Person) WHERE EXISTS { (:Person)-[:SUPERVISED]->(s) }
MATCH path = (root:Person)-[:SUPERVISED*1..]->(s)
WHERE NOT EXISTS { (:Person)-[:SUPERVISED]->(root) }
WITH s, path, nodes(path) AS ns
OPTIONAL MATCH (gp:Person)-[:SUPERVISED*2]->(s)
RETURN s.name AS doctoral_researcher,
       [n IN ns | n.name] AS supervision_chain_root_to_researcher,
       gp.name AS academic_grandparent
ORDER BY doctoral_researcher
Answer: [{"doctoral_researcher": "Arjun Menon", "supervision_chain_root_to_researcher": ["Priya Raghunathan", "Arjun Menon"], "academic_grandparent": null}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Hannah Brooks", "supervision_chain_root_to_researcher": ["Daniel Okafor", "Hannah Brooks"], "academic_grandparent": null}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Ingrid Solberg", "supervision_chain_root_to_researcher": ["Markus Weber", "Ingrid Solberg"], "academic_grandparent": null}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Sofia Lindqvist", "supervision_chain_root_to_researcher": ["Markus Weber", "Ingrid Solberg", "Sofia Lindqvist"], "academic_grandparent": "Markus Weber"}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Tomas Berg", "supervision_chain_root_to_researcher": ["Markus Weber", "Ingrid Solberg", "Tomas Berg"], "academic_grandparent": "Markus Weber"}]

Question: Mobility: Which researchers have been affiliated with more than one organization (employment or study), and what was the direction of each move?
Cypher Query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[r:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(o:Organization)
WITH p, r, o ORDER BY p.name, r.seq
WITH p, collect({org:o.name, kind:r.kind, start:r.start, end:r.end}) AS affs
WHERE size(affs) > 1
RETURN p.name AS researcher,
       [i IN range(0, size(affs)-2) |
          affs[i].org + ' (' + affs[i].kind + ') -> ' + affs[i+1].org + ' (' + affs[i+1].kind + ')'] AS moves
ORDER BY researcher
Answer: [{"researcher": "Elena Voss", "moves": ["Rhine Valley University (employment) -> Lumen Storage Systems (employment)"]}, {"researcher": "Hannah Brooks", "moves": ["Maple Ridge University (study) -> Pacific Cell Technologies (employment)"]}, {"researcher": "Ingrid Solberg", "moves": ["Rhine Valley University (study) -> Halvorsen Institute of Technology (employment)"]}, {"researcher": "Priya Raghunathan", "moves": ["Southern Peninsula Institute of Science (employment) -> Maple Ridge University (visiting)"]}, {"researcher": "Tomas Berg", "moves": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology (study) -> Fjordgrid AS (employment)"]}]

Question: Citation influence: Which publications cite the 2022 cathode stability paper, directly or indirectly (transitive citation chain)?

RETURN citing.title AS citing_publication, citing.year AS year,

Question: Collaboration horizon: Starting from the Halvorsen Institute of Technology, which organizations are reachable within two project-collaboration hops, and through which projects?
Cypher Query:
MATCH (hit:Organization {name:'Halvorsen Institute of Technology'})
CALL (hit) {
  MATCH (hit)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Project)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(o:Organization)
  WHERE o <> hit
  RETURN o, 1 AS hops, collect(DISTINCT p.name) AS via
  UNION
  MATCH (hit)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p1:Project)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(m:Organization)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p2:Project)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(o:Organization)
  WHERE m <> hit AND o <> hit AND o <> m AND NOT EXISTS { (hit)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(:Project)<-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(o) }
  RETURN o, 2 AS hops, collect(DISTINCT p1.name + ' -> ' + m.name + ' -> ' + p2.name) AS via
}
RETURN o.name AS organization, hops, via AS reached_through_projects
ORDER BY hops, organization
Answer: [{"organization": "Fjordgrid AS", "hops": 1, "reached_through_projects": ["ALPINE"]}, {"organization": "Lumen Storage Systems", "hops": 1, "reached_through_projects": ["ALPINE"]}, {"organization": "Maple Ridge University", "hops": 1, "reached_through_projects": ["CASCADE"]}, {"organization": "Pacific Cell Technologies", "hops": 1, "reached_through_projects": ["CASCADE"]}, {"organization": "Rhine Valley University", "hops": 1, "reached_through_projects": ["ALPINE"]}, {"organization": "Deccan Power Corporation", "hops": 2, "reached_through_projects": ["CASCADE -> Maple Ridge University -> MONSOON"]}, {"organization": "Southern Peninsula Institute of Science", "hops": 2, "reached_through_projects": ["CASCADE -> Maple Ridge University -> MONSOON"]}]

Question: Collaborator recommendation: Suggest pairs of researchers who have never co-authored but share at least one common co-author, and whose work relates to the same technology area.
